source.download_date_evidence: Local raw-file creation and last-modified dates are both 2026-10-28; no separate download log was checked.

method.sampling: Normalize and retain all English seed concept paths; select the lexicographically smallest distinct English concepts directly adjacent to any seed up to max_nodes, independent of source row order; scan the assertions file twice.
method.cleaning: Keep valid English base concept endpoints; remove self-loops; treat edges as undirected, merge reverse and repeated edges, union relation categories, and retain the maximum weight for each node pair.
method.distance_pairs: Count unordered node pairs with shortest-path distance exactly 2 or exactly 3 in the largest connected component.

limitations: The person node has degree 355 in this graph and can dominate connectivity and short-path candidate counts.
The lexicographic truncation of seed neighbors favors alphabetically early concept identifiers and is not a representative or random sample.
